mechanismNote: Inline mechanism per D203/D204. Not a question that was put to him: he volunteered the rule, so it is recorded under D227 with an empty options list and his reasoning in his own terms.
readback: Recorded from his own words and told to him in one line, per D227.
finalComments: Resolves a contradiction this created in CLAUDE.md, which previously told a session to treat a push the way it would treat sending an email on the representatives' behalf. That caution is not deleted but moved to where it belongs: adding a person's name, address or photograph to the page, rather than publishing an edit he asked for.

D4.question: Does a push follow every edit automatically, or is publishing a separate decision each time?
D4.label: Commit and push on every edit
D4.why: since it's a small website for some students, the publishing stakes are not that high, so every time you do an edit you should commit and push
